buildCommand: python -c "import shutil, os, rest_framework; src=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(rest_framework.__file__), 'static', 'rest_framework'); dest=os.path.join(os.getcwd(), 'staticfiles', 'rest_framework'); os.makedirs(dest, exist_ok=True); shutil.copytree(src, dest, dirs_exist_ok=True)" && python manage.py collectstatic --noinput
